speaker: abel_garnish
text: Master Will. The house is done with you for today. The licensed book. Take it. I want it again before the house asks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow it goes under my cloak to Blackfriars. He reads it with the door shut. I am not giving him the foul papers.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: This copy. No supper stain. No Princess improved at a table.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not a loss. Out, and back before the house asks. I am not entering it as gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chronicle does not go. The king does not go. This book goes.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I know which book is which. Take it. Edith is at an elbow, and I can hear her from this stair.
